title: 第21章 他杀你你应该感恩才对第22章 我也欺负一下你们
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 吼！
赤甲狮发出低吼咆哮。
震耳欲聋的声音传来，过往的人都吓了一跳。
乾素素看到赤甲狮紧盯着秦云和她，顿时小脸苍白。
秦云皱了皱眉。
这赤甲狮发什么疯？
秦云不知道赤甲狮到底怎么了，反正感觉到赤甲狮死死盯着自己，而且发出低吼威胁。
难道是自己身上的妖血丹的气息？
应该是了。
不然赤甲狮不会突然盯着自己。
当初秦云留了一些低阶妖兽炼制出来的妖血丹，随身带着，想着以后有用，却没想到会被赤甲狮盯上。
赤甲狮咧嘴露出锋利的牙齿，它朝前迈出了一步。
乾素素已经吓得不敢动了。
秦云绷着脸。
自己的修为根本打不过赤甲狮，动用战技的话，只会死得更快，现在唯一能用的就是御兽诀了。
只是能不能压制赤甲狮，秦云没有把握。
不管了。
先用再说。
秦云运转御兽诀，眸子有光闪过，只见原本在低吼咆哮的赤甲狮瞬间僵住了，它不由收敛了凶戾的模样。
这个时候，秦云发现自己和赤甲狮之间有了一种很奇妙的联系。
这时，赤甲狮趴了下来，并将头压低在地上。
御兽成功了？
秦云眉毛微微一挑。
没想到竟然能成功御兽，而且还是高阶妖兽赤甲狮。
只是秦云和赤甲狮的联系很微弱，只能暂时驾驭而已，不能长时间的掌控驾驭，不然会被赤甲狮反噬。
虽然只能暂时驾驭，但也足够了。
至少，现在不用担心被赤甲狮攻击了。
“刚刚是你们惊扰了守门妖兽？”
一道森冷的声音从里面传来，负责管理赤甲狮的中年管事沉着脸看着秦云。
他看出秦云和乾素素二人穿着普通，明显就是个平民。
“这只守门妖兽是你管的？”
秦云指向赤甲狮问道。
“我问你话呢，你反倒来问我？你的长辈没教你规矩是吧？还是说，你有爹娘生，没爹娘养？”
中年管事冷冷说道。
“我爹娘管不管我，与你有何关系？要说没规矩，你更是一点规矩都没有，你乃大乾学府管事，我等过来就是客人，你连尊重客人都不懂，还和我说规矩。”
秦云毫不示弱地反驳道。
“哎哟！
反了天，你还敢顶嘴。
content_en:
roar!
The red-armored lion roared.
The deafening sound came, and people passing by were startled.
Gan Susu's face suddenly turned pale when she saw the red-armored lion staring closely at Qin Yun and her.
Qin Yun frowned.
Why is this red-armored lion so crazy?
Qin Yun didn't know what happened to the red-armored lion, but he felt that the red-armored lion was staring at him and growling threateningly.
Could it be the aura of the demon blood pill on his body?
It should be.
Otherwise, the red-armored lion would not suddenly stare at him.
At the beginning, Qin Yun kept some demon blood pills refined by low-level demon beasts and carried them with him, thinking that they would be useful in the future, but he did not expect that he would be targeted by the red-armored lion.
The red-armored lion grinned, revealing its sharp teeth, and took a step forward.
Qian Susu was too scared to move.
Qin Yun's face was grim.
My own cultivation level cannot defeat the red-armored lion at all. If I use combat skills, I will only die faster. The only thing I can use now is the Beast Control Technique.
But Qin Yun was not sure whether he could suppress the red-armored lion.
Never mind.
Use it first and then talk about it.
Qin Yun ran the Beast Control Technique, and a light flashed through his eyes. He saw the red-armored lion that was roaring suddenly froze, and it couldn't help but restrain its ferocious appearance.
At this time, Qin Yun discovered that he had a wonderful connection with the red-armored lion.
At this time, the red-armored lion lay down and lowered his head to the ground.
Was the beast control successful?
Qin Yun raised his eyebrows slightly.
Unexpectedly, he could successfully control a beast, and it was also a high-level monster, a red-armored lion.
It's just that the connection between Qin Yun and the red-armored lion is very weak, and he can only control it temporarily. He cannot control it for a long time, otherwise it will be backlashed by the red-armored lion.
Although it can only be controlled temporarily, it is enough.
At least, now there is no need to worry about being attacked by the red-armored lion.
"Did you just disturb the gatekeeper monster?"
A cold voice came from inside, and the middle-aged steward in charge of the Red Armored Lion looked at Qin Yun with a stern expression.
He saw that Qin Yun and Qian Susu were wearing ordinary clothes and were obviously civilians.
"Are you in charge of this gatekeeper monster?"
Qin Yun pointed at the red-armored lion and asked.
"I'm asking you a question, but you're asking me instead? Your elders didn't teach you the rules, right? Or is it that you have parents, but not parents?"
The middle-aged steward said coldly.
"My parents don't care about me, what does it have to do with you? If you don't have any rules, you don't have any rules at all. You are in charge of the university, and I will be a guest when I come here. You don't even know how to respect guests, and you still tell me the rules."
Qin Yun retorted without showing any weakness.
"Ouch!
How dare you talk back to me.
